payload.rebuttal: fixed: The ordering itself is correct and intentional: the spec text I was given explicitly says 'Replace saffron/task.py:780-787 with a call to refuse_inline_mutants, then the helper, both inside the existing try... A spec that declares one and pins a commit the mirror lacks now prints the inline reason, since that check runs first.' Reverting to the old has_commit-first order would contradict that instruction. What the critic correctly identified is a real coverage gap: no test exercised the combination of an inline-declaring spec with a task that also pins an unreadable commit, so a regression to the old order would have gone unnoticed. I added case 6 to test_run_task_refuses_an_inline_mutant_or_an_unreadable_mutants_file_before_its_cell in tests/test_task.py: a spec with an inline mutant whose task pins a commit the mirror lacks, asserting the reason names the inline witness and not the missing commit's hash.
